name: cdep
description: Client Data Exchange Protocol: capability discovery and user-approved dataset transfer between browser applications, with no backend.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/sequence-app/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/tree-viewer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/hello-sender/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/hello-receiver/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm e2e
